name: @sls/memos-memory
description: Paperclip memory plugin backed by self-hosted MemOS: Jev-gated short memories, pre-prompt recall for claude_local and codex_local

scripts.check: find src ui e2e test bin -type f \( -name '*.js' -o -name '*.mjs' -o -path 'bin/*' \) -print0 | xargs -0 -n1 node --check && node -e "import('./src/manifest.js').then((m) => { if (!m.default?.id) process.exit(1); })" && npm test
